note: Rule list of the Labeling Rules (site/guide.md). Picking a rule is optional. The tool reads id, dataset, label, title and text; source is documentation only.

rules.label: normal
rules.title: Severity not FATAL / FAILURE
rules.text: The severity (the word after RAS|NULL <COMPONENT>) is not FATAL and not FAILURE.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: data TLB error interrupt
rules.text: FATAL/FAILURE; message contains `data TLB error interrupt`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: data storage interrupt
rules.text: FATAL/FAILURE; message contains `data storage interrupt`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: ciod: Error reading message prefix … CioStream
rules.text: FATAL/FAILURE; message contains `ciod: Error reading message prefix` and `CioStream`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: Lustre mount FAILED
rules.text: FATAL/FAILURE; message contains `Lustre mount FAILED`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: rts: kernel terminated for reason
rules.text: FATAL/FAILURE; message contains `rts: kernel terminated for reason`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: Error receiving packet on tree network
rules.text: FATAL/FAILURE; message contains `Error receiving packet on tree network`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: ciod: failed to read message prefix on control stream
rules.text: FATAL/FAILURE; message contains `ciod: failed to read message prefix on control stream`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: rts panic! - stopping execution
rules.text: FATAL/FAILURE; message contains `rts panic! - stopping execution`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: ciod: Error creating node map from file
rules.text: FATAL/FAILURE; message contains `ciod: Error creating node map from file`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: machine check interrupt
rules.text: FATAL/FAILURE; message contains `machine check interrupt`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: kernel panic (KERNEL)
rules.text: FATAL/FAILURE; component is KERNEL and message contains `kernel panic`.

rules.label: normal
rules.title: FATAL / FAILURE, no alert rule
rules.text: Severity is FATAL or FAILURE and no rule B-A01 … B-A11 applies.
rules.source: DSN 2007, §3.2, Table 2 caption, Table 5 caption; ICDM 2008, §1, §3.1

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: [KERNEL_IB] … Local Catastrophic Error
rules.text: The line contains `[KERNEL_IB]` and `Local Catastrophic Error`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: Connection refused (111) in open_demux
rules.text: The line contains `Connection refused (111) in open_demux`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: mptscsih: … attempting task abort!
rules.text: The line contains `mptscsih:` and `attempting task abort!`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: EXT3-fs error … Detected aborted journal
rules.text: The line contains `EXT3-fs error` and `Detected aborted journal`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: Losing some ticks
rules.text: The line contains `Losing some ticks... checking if CPU frequency changed.`

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: rejecting I/O to offline device
rules.text: The line contains `rejecting I/O to offline device`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: EventID: 1404 … Memory device
rules.text: The line contains `EventID: 1404` and `Memory device`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: Bad file descriptor (9) in tm_request
rules.text: The line contains `Bad file descriptor (9) in tm_request`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: check-disks … Fault Status assert
rules.text: The line contains `check-disks` and `Fault Status assert`.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: NMI received
rules.text: The line contains `NMI received`.

rules.label: normal
rules.title: No alert rule
rules.text: No rule T-A01 … T-A10 applies.

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: Failure event in the trace
rules.text: The trace contains any of T7, T8, T10, T12, T13, T14, T17, T20, T24, T27, T28, T29, T31, T32.
rules.source: Xu et al., SOSP 2009, Table 7 (#2, #5–#11); Landauer et al., FSE 2024, §3.1, Table 1, Fig. 2

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: Write not complete
rules.source: Xu et al., SOSP 2009, §6.4 and Table 7 (#2, #3); Landauer et al., FSE 2024, §3.1

rules.label: anomaly
rules.title: Re-replication, then file deletion
rules.text: T25 (re-replication) and T23 (file deletion) both occur.
rules.source: Xu et al., SOSP 2009, §6.3 and Table 7 (#1, #4)

rules.label: normal
rules.title: Re-replication without file deletion
rules.text: T25 occurs, T23 does not, and no rule above applies.
rules.source: Xu et al., SOSP 2009, Table 7 (false positive: Normal background migration)

rules.label: normal
rules.title: Complete write, no anomaly rule
rules.text: Any trace not decided by H-A01, H-A02, H-A03, H-U01 or H-N02.
rules.source: Xu et al., SOSP 2009, §6.3, Table 7 (false positive: Multiple replica), HADOOP-3678; Landauer et al., FSE 2024, §3.1, Fig. 4

rules.label: unknown
rules.title: T1, T15 or T19 without a deciding rule
rules.text: The trace contains T1, T15 or T19 and none of H-A01, H-A02, H-A03 applies.
rules.source: No published type covers these events

rules.label: unknown
rules.title: Text unreadable
rules.text: The raw text is empty, cut off or garbled so that it cannot be checked against the rules.
